newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zaire's Mobutu taken to hospital again.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu taken to hospital again.

text.p: Zaire President Mobutu Sese Seko, whose army has lost his country's third largest city to rebels, was admitted to a hospital in Monte Carlo on Sunday for further cancer treatment, an aide said.
"It is only treatment and the president is well," a spokesman at Mobutu's French Riviera villa told Reuters by telephone.
He said Mobutu would spend the night at Princess Grace hospital in the principality of Monaco and he might be there a few days, but his condition was "no cause for concern".
The veteran ruler has spent much of his time at his luxury home in Roquebrune-Cap Martin since he underwent prostate cancer surgery in Switzerland last August.
He came back to France on February 21 and had been due to return to Zaire last week, according to his son and spokesman Mobutu Nzanga, but his departure was delayed, apparently for medical reasons.

Tutsi rebels led by Laurent Kabila captured the strategic city of Kisangani on the Zaire river on Saturday, completing their sweep of eastern Zaire as government troops looted the city and fled virtually without a fight.
